name: scf_density_cuda
scope: Build-time CUDA lowering of canonical SCF plain and energy-weighted density TensorIR for RHF/UHF integer occupations. Plain density contracts one upper-triangle AO pair and mirrors the completed value; weighted density retains full-square evaluation to preserve its qualified FP64 multiplication order. Native code retains launch, stream, active-item, warm-start and solver/runtime ownership.
